sources: binary inspection 2026-09-18 of every released ninja binary: PE machine/subsystem/imports, Mach-O archs/minos, highest GLIBC_ symbol
choosing: Ninja is backwards compatible for build files, so pick the newest release that runs: Windows XP or any 32-bit Windows -> 1.6.0 (the only x86 builds are 1.4.0-1.6.0); Windows Vista x64+ -> newest; macOS 10.6-10.11 -> 1.8.2, 10.12-10.14 -> 1.11.1, 10.15+ -> newest; Linux glibc 2.4-2.14 -> 1.8.2, 2.15+ -> newest. Consumers' minimums: Meson 1.x needs ninja >= 1.8.2 (error message of 1.12.0: 'Could not detect Ninja v1.8.2 or newer'); CMake Ninja Multi-Config needs 1.10, C++20 modules 1.11.
